description: This file defines the SecurePayPaymentServices class which implements various payment-related operations (authorization, capture, void, refund, credit) for interacting with the SecurePay payment gateway in the OFBiz framework. It handles building configuration properties, creating payment transactions, and processing responses.

classes.name: SecurePayPaymentServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to perform payment operations via SecurePay integration in OFBiz.

methods.name: doAuth
methods.description: Performs payment authorization by sending transaction details to SecurePay and processing the response.

methods.name: ccReAuth
methods.description: Placeholder for credit card re-authorization, currently returns success without processing.

methods.name: doCapture
methods.description: Captures an authorized payment transaction in SecurePay.

methods.name: doVoid
methods.description: Voids a previously authorized transaction in SecurePay.

methods.name: doRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a completed transaction in SecurePay.

methods.name: doCredit
methods.description: Issuance of a credit (refund or chargeback) transaction in SecurePay.

methods.name: buildScProperties
methods.description: Constructs configuration properties for SecurePay from the payment gateway configuration.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific configuration values for SecurePay from either the database or properties files, with overload supporting default values.
